shared_elements: low-relief figures carved on a flat rectangular panel
a row of repeated, similar motifs arranged in a band or register
an anthropomorphic figure among other motifs
division of the surface into horizontal registers/vertical fields
justification: Both surfaces organise raised figures into registers or fields and both include profile creatures and a small human-like figure, but these are the most generic possibilities of relief imagery. A shows sparse, isolated, highly schematic animals (birds, quadrupeds, a snake-like form) on a bare ground, while B shows a densely packed, elaborately costumed standing person with plumed headdress flanked by columns of repeated sign-blocks — no specific motif, attribute or relationship is shared.
